positive_findings.pre_attempt_payload_access: 0 payload-member stat/open/hash; the full M785 verifier was not called
positive_findings.semantic_schema: M1049 aliases, camel/case/plural variants, nonfinite/bool/extra shapes and result injections were rejected
positive_findings.d1: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY is exact-bound; scheduled/generator/numeric admission remains false
positive_findings.authority: wrong review SHA, manifest SHA, outer seal SHA and status were rejected
positive_findings.runtime: missing/wrong caller pins, five namespaces and direct run bypass were rejected without canonical state change
positive_findings.failure_isolation: a synthetic post-attempt verifier failure preserved the attempt and moved work to quarantine

blocking_findings.finding: validate_payload_receipt requires only 64-hex syntax for attempt_receipt_sha256, M699 manifest/root/outer identities and selected-record packed_sha256, and does not bind selected paths or raw record identities. assemble calls that weak validator without the canonical attempt or frozen manifest context.
blocking_findings.reproduction: A receipt with all four root/attempt SHA values forged, every selected packed SHA forged, and every relative_path naming a nonexistent calls/FORGED_DOES_NOT_EXIST.npz was accepted by validate_payload_receipt.
blocking_findings.impact: After a real run, payload and raw record identities can be relabeled and their dependent file hashes refreshed; assemble can then double-seal the relabeled output without a replay. This violates M1049's exact-identity repair requirement.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Bind root identities to the frozen contract, bind attempt_receipt_sha256 to the canonical attempt receipt, bind each selected record to the fully verified frozen manifest, and cross-bind each raw layer record_identity to the corresponding selected record. The assembler must receive or derive these authoritative identities and reject mutations before writing seals.

required_next_gate.new_namespace: M1056 or later; M1052/M1054 remain immutable and non-authoritative
must_retest: frozen root and canonical attempt exact identity binding
selected manifest record and raw record cross-binding
post-run identity/hash mutations rejected before sealing
flock, EDA, resource and namespace gates
